title: Kryeit Server
description: Modded technical Minecraft centred around the Create mod, yet a relaxed environment to play on. You can find here a long-term mindset, a friendly community and a lot of moss.
body:
![Kryeit Server Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e8bb4d1d87c1c3b5b30c315170fdafb7b804298_0.webp)

## About this server

Kryeit is a relaxed modded survival multiplayer server focused around the Create mod. We aim for a simple modpack and long seasons. Our current season is over two years old and will last for many more years.

Players come and go, but memories and your epic builds stay, so go and leave your mark on our ever-growing world :)
